name: RustberryPi maintenance
description: Select one job or all jobs for a shared maintenance window. Requires a mounted NAS backup destination.

spec.question_description: All runs OS, pinned FEX, Rust, then detected Hailo hardware with one countdown and backup, independently of inference enablement. Hailo requires private firmware approval and builds/revalidates for the post-OS running kernel; hosts without Hailo explicitly skip it.
600 gives ten minutes. Zero still announces immediately before saving and stopping.

spec.question_name: FEX commit (required for fex or all)
spec.question_description: Exact 40-character commit, reviewed before launch; never automatic latest.

spec.question_name: FEX version (required for fex or all)
spec.question_description: Version label matching the selected commit. Also persist both desired pins in private host vars.

For hailo, blank selects the newest ready local candidate; no candidate fails before downtime. For all with detected Hailo hardware, blank pins the newest common stable 4.x release before downtime and builds/revalidates after OS work. Exact 4.x overrides remain supported; all validates common-stable eligibility before downtime. Already-current all verifies hardware without upgrading.
